description: Reads the metadata of a public URL: title, description, preview image, favicon, site name, author, publication date, language and feeds. A quick way to learn what a link points to without reading the page.

fresh.description: When true, bypasses the one-hour cache.

render.description: When true, loads the page in a headless browser before reading its tags.

url.description: The page to preview. `https://` is assumed when the scheme is omitted.

verify_image.description: When true, downloads the preview image to confirm it exists and to report its real dimensions and type.

name: preview_link
title: Preview a link
